items.name: DFW Cubing Winter 2027
items.information: Cubing returns to the Grapevine Convention Center for DFW Cubing Winter 2027! ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.*** This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)

items.name: FTO in Versoix 2027

venue.name: Salle communale Lachenal
venue.details: La compétition se déroule dans la grande salle. On peut y entrer depuis le rez-de-chaussée.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MDkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--84e4edf1c283f775bdc003094c6b7e11586c06ea/option1_1_250x250.png) [FR] 🇨🇵 On est de retour à Genève pour la première compétition FTO de Suisse romande ! Tous ceux qui souhaitent commencer l’année avec un résultat FTO officiel sont les bienvenus. Cette compétition marque la fin de près de deux ans d’absence de compétitions à Genève, tout en offrant aux cubers locaux l’occasion de participer à cet événement WCA récemment reconnu. __________________________________________________________________ [EN] 🇬🇧 We’re back in Geneva for the first FTO competition in Romandie! Anyone wanting to start the year with an official FTO result is welcome. This competition marks the end of a nearly two-year hiatus from competitions in Geneva, while offering local cubers the chance to take part in this newly recognised WCA event.

items.name: North Star Cubing Challenge MN 2027
items.information: This is the 9th annual North Star Cubing Challenge competition in Minnesota! This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2lJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1f97c854b41905e0a0658611c178db646a55f666/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
